settings.title: Settings
settings.headNote: Most settings take effect immediately on save; the listen port and proxy URL require a service restart
settings.adminPasswordUpdated: Admin Password updated. Please log in again with the new password.
settings.adminPasswordHint: Takes effect immediately; the old password will stop working. You'll need to log in again after changing the Admin Password.
settings.selectStrategyDesc: Priority Mode picks accounts in priority order; Balanced Load rotates requests across available accounts.
settings.suggestionModeDesc: Controls whether the client's automatic next-input prediction request after each turn is forwarded. When enabled, the terminal shows AI suggestions in real time, but each sent message incurs an extra full-context billed request (default CC client behavior); when disabled (default), the server intercepts it and returns an empty response with zero token usage.
settings.thinkingAsTextDesc: Claude Code only. When enabled, extended-thinking content is streamed line by line (like Kiro CLI; dimmed gray for the cli entrypoint, a Markdown blockquote with italics for other entrypoints), fixing Claude Code's default collapsed thinking that makes long reasoning look frozen; enabled by default; disable to keep native thinking blocks. In both modes Claude Code's own context contains the thinking content, but it is dropped entirely when history is sent upstream (off: native thinking blocks; on: marker line, thinking body and duration line), so the upstream context never contains thinking. Hot-switchable, applies to new requests only.
settings.showSessionCreditsDesc: Claude Code only. When enabled, the last line of a reply shows credit usage once a conversation actually ends (intermediate tool-call steps are skipped), e.g. “▸ Credits: turn 0.86 • session 8.73 | Time: 12s”: turn is the credits spent in this turn (all requests under one prompt), session is the running total for the conversation since this was enabled, and Time is the turn duration. Totals are accumulated by the proxy from the credits reported on each upstream request and reset when the service restarts; dimmed gray for the cli entrypoint, Markdown italics for other entrypoints. The line is stripped before history is sent upstream, so it never enters the upstream context or output_tokens. Auxiliary requests without tool definitions (title generation, compaction, etc.) are skipped; non-streaming requests are not supported. Disabled by default, hot-switchable, applies to new requests only.
settings.dumpKiroBodyDesc: Debug/forensics switch. When enabled, every final request body sent to Kiro is written to app/config/kiro-body-dump/ (file permission 0600) for troubleshooting protocol conversion issues; disabled by default. Hot-switchable, applies to new requests only; turn it off promptly after diagnosis to avoid unbounded disk growth.
settings.debugLogsDesc: When enabled, DEBUG-level events are emitted live to the console, the log file and the Log Viewer page (all three in sync, no restart needed). Off by default — turn it on temporarily for troubleshooting; log volume grows significantly, so it is recommended to switch it off after diagnosis. DEBUG entries already captured are retained when switched off.
settings.clientTokenPassthroughDesc: Controls whether the usage fields are reported 1:1 with real token consumption. When enabled (default), actual values are passed through, for third-party clients that compute context usage from returned usage; when disabled, values are scaled by 0.6657 for display, which can appropriately delay Claude Code's existing auto-compact trigger timing.
settings.maxRpmPerCredentialDesc: Maximum requests per minute for each account; hot-applied on save (0 = unlimited).
settings.writeChunkingMaxLinesDesc: When a request carries Write / Edit / MultiEdit, the system prompt asks for no more than about N lines per tool call, so the upstream does not reset the stream after ~240s of silence on a huge tool argument. Larger saves credits (fewer split turns, fewer re-thinks) but makes the 240s reset more likely; smaller is safer but costs more; 0 = do not append the instruction. Default 300. Hot-applied on save; affects new requests only.
settings.portDesc: HTTP port the service listens on (1–65535). Saved to config.json; takes effect after restart.
settings.proxyUrlDesc: Proxy for upstream requests (http/https/socks5); leave empty for direct connection. Saved to config.json; takes effect after restart.
settings.runtimeConfigSaveHint: port and proxyUrl changes take effect after restart
